articles.title: IN BRIEF: Putin comments on Russia's strategic goals, security, Duma election
articles.summary: Putin stated at a United Russia party congress that Russia is pushing ahead with strategic plans despite external pressure, pledging to ensure national security during a crucial period of global transformation.

articles.title: Putin orders to minimize impact from Kiev's terrorist attacks on civilian infrastructure
articles.summary: Putin authorized efforts to minimize the impact of Ukrainian terrorist attacks on Russian civilian facilities during a meeting discussing domestic fuel supplies.

articles.title: IN BRIEF: Putin's statements on Russia-ASEAN interaction, US-Iran agreements
articles.summary: Putin expressed hope that US-Iran agreements would form the basis for future peace and noted productive talks between Russia and ASEAN nations at the Kazan summit.
